intro.t: Art burned, painted and *made right here.*
intro.text: Jennifer Bardram is the Long Island artist behind J33 Art Studios, known online as The Snarky Pyro. She burns detailed designs into wood, then brings them to life with color: coral reefs, sunflowers, poppies, sharks and the harbor scenes we all know. You'll find her booth at Gallery North's Outdoor Art Show and the Art League of Long Island, and her work in homes all over Three Village.
intro.quote: Local art made by a neighbor. The kind of piece people ask about every time they walk in the room.

services.d: Hand wood-burned art, often finished with paint washes, on wood slices and planks.
Oil, ink and watercolor, including Long Island harbor and nautical scenes.
Custom portraits and one-of-a-kind pieces made for you.

faq: Can I order a custom piece?
Yes. Jennifer takes custom portraits and commissions. Send a message to get started.
Where can I buy her art?
Online at j33art.com, and at her booth during local art shows like Gallery North's Outdoor Art Show.
It's the art of burning a design into wood with a heated tool. Jennifer often adds color washes to finish each piece.
